text.en:
• Does it work offline? Yes — the rep app works offline and syncs automatically when the connection returns.
• Is invoicing ZATCA-compliant? Yes, in both phases, with a QR code on every invoice.
• Do I need devices or servers? No — it’s cloud-based and runs on reps’ phones and the browser.
• Can it print invoices? Yes, on portable Bluetooth printers.
• Does it connect to my accounting system? Yes, through an API and a ready Odoo connector.
